item.title: Sotto 0.1.1
item.description:
• Sotto now updates itself: it checks once a day and offers new versions, or choose Check for Updates… in the menu.
  • Updates keep the Accessibility permission and the downloaded cleanup model.
  • "Scratch that" matches more loosely, and spoken lists are typed as real lists.
